event.canonical_title: Iran and Oman Near Agreement on Strait of Hormuz, Excluding US Involvement
event.summary: Iran has announced that it is in the final stages of drafting an agreement with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian government has clarified that the United States is not involved in these negotiations. No comments have been made by either the US or Oman on the proposed agreement.

timeline.title: Iran and Oman Establish Temporary Shipping Corridor in Strait of Hormuz
timeline.summary: Iran and Oman have reached an agreement to create a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, facilitating the transit of commercial vessels. Iran's deputy foreign minister announced the initiative amid ongoing tensions, as Tehran rejected US claims regarding the clearance of mines in the area and indicated that the strait could remain closed unless its conditions are met.
key_facts: Iran and Oman agreed on a temporary shipping corridor.
The corridor is intended for commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran dismissed US claims about mine clearance.
